question: Loại giao hàng nào mất nhiều thời gian hơn từ lúc đặt đến lúc giao xong?

sql_by_dialect.postgresql: SELECT delivery_type AS delivery_type, AVG(CASE WHEN is_test_order = FALSE AND is_delivered = TRUE THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_time - order_date)) / 3600.0 END) AS average_delivery_lead_time_hours FROM fact_orders GROUP BY delivery_type ORDER BY delivery_type
sql_by_dialect.mysql: SELECT delivery_type AS delivery_type, AVG(CASE WHEN is_test_order = FALSE AND is_delivered = TRUE THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, order_date, delivered_time) / 60.0 END) AS average_delivery_lead_time_hours FROM fact_orders GROUP BY delivery_type ORDER BY delivery_type
sql_by_dialect.sqlite: SELECT delivery_type AS delivery_type, AVG(CASE WHEN is_test_order = FALSE AND is_delivered = TRUE THEN (julianday(delivered_time) - julianday(order_date)) * 24.0 END) AS average_delivery_lead_time_hours FROM fact_orders GROUP BY delivery_type ORDER BY delivery_type

question: Giá trị đơn trung bình theo thành phố?

sql_by_dialect.postgresql: SELECT cities.city_name AS city_name, SUM(CASE WHEN fact_orders.is_test_order = FALSE AND fact_orders.is_canceled = FALSE THEN fact_orders.gross_amount - fact_orders.discount_amount - fact_orders.return_amount END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_orders.is_test_order = FALSE AND fact_orders.is_canceled = FALSE THEN fact_orders.order_id END), 0) AS average_order_value FROM fact_orders JOIN customers ON fact_orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN customer_addresses ON customers.default_address_id = customer_addresses.address_id JOIN cities ON customer_addresses.city_id = cities.city_id GROUP BY cities.city_name ORDER BY cities.city_name

question: Tỷ lệ đơn dùng thẻ thành viên theo vùng miền?

sql_by_dialect.postgresql: SELECT cities.region_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_orders.is_test_order = FALSE AND fact_orders.loyalty_card_id IS NOT NULL THEN fact_orders.order_id END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fact_orders.is_test_order = FALSE THEN fact_orders.order_id END), 0) AS loyalty_order_penetration FROM fact_orders JOIN customers ON fact_orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN customer_addresses ON customers.default_address_id = customer_addresses.address_id JOIN cities ON customer_addresses.city_id = cities.city_id GROUP BY cities.region_name ORDER BY cities.region_name
